title: The CMS clock report says zero late decisions
scenario: Kestrel Health Plan's Q4 CMS-0057-F metrics show zero late standard decisions, but the external auditor found five. The analytics team suspects the November time change. The same deadline code drives the nurse reviewers' time-remaining column.
task: Reproduce the report and compare it with the audit sample
Find the root cause and decide whether the DST warnings matter
Fix the code, re-run the report, fill in findings.json
Explain impact and prevention in ANSWER.md
acceptance: Standard deadline is 7 calendar days on the plan wall clock; expedited stays 72 hours
Late counts and ids match an independent recompute; audit cases confirmed
Root cause backed by traced cases and before/after numbers
